questions.question: Gel filtration utilizes the _________ of a protein.
Four proteins A, B, C and D are of 5 nm, 2 nm, 10 nm and 7 nm in diameter. When loaded into a gel filtration column having pore size of 5 nm,

answers.c: C and D will be excluded from the column.
answers.d: A and B will not enter the beads.

questions.question: The molecular weight of a protein is found to be 120 kDa in gel filtration chromatography. The same protein when analysed with SDS-PAGE gave a molecular weight of 40 kDa. The oligomeric status of the protein is
A purified protein sample has high amount of salt. The protein can be separated from the salt by gel filtration chromatography as

answers.a: The salt elutes in the void volume.
answers.b: The protein elutes after the salt.
answers.c: The salt elutes after the protein.
answers.d: The salt binds irreversibly into the matrix.
